parallels.note: They were glad, and agreed to give him money.

translations.web: They, when they heard it, were glad, and promised to give him money. He sought how he might conveniently deliver him.
translations.bsb: They were delighted to hear this, and they promised to give him money. So Judas began to look for an opportunity to betray Jesus.
translations.kjv: And when they heard it, they were glad, and promised to give him money. And he sought how he might conveniently betray him.
translations.asv: And they, when they heard it, were glad, and promised to give him money. And he sought how he might conveniently deliver him unto them.
